description.fun: Nothing ruffles Bidoof. With nerves of steel and a famously unbothered face, it has been known to saunter into villages and gnaw on the houses without a care. Its front teeth never stop growing, so it keeps them in check by chewing logs and rocks. The Pokémon Company even declared 1 July 2021 Bidoof Day, with its own parody music video.
description.guide: Bidoof is a Normal-type beaver-like Pokémon from Sinnoh. Its incisors never stop growing, so it gnaws on wood and rock, and it nests in groups by the water. It evolves into Bibarel.
description.tagline: An unflappable beaver that gnaws on anything, houses included.

description.fun: Bibarel is nature's civil engineer: it dams streams with bark, branches and mud, and a river it has dammed never overflows its banks, to the delight of people living nearby. Slow and awkward on land, it is a swift swimmer, and its water-repellent fur holds heat well. Its name mixes beaver (Biber in German) with barrel.
description.guide: Bibarel is the evolved form of Bidoof, a Normal- and Water-type beaver. It builds dams from branches, roots and mud, and it is a much better swimmer than walker.
description.tagline: A hard-working beaver whose dams never let a river flood.
